known_truth_simulation.estimand: ATE_ratio = E[units | promotion] / E[units | no promotion] - 1 (multiplicative effect of a promotion day)
known_truth_simulation.estimator: OLS on log(1+units) with promotion, marketing, weekday, series effects and series-specific linear trends; cluster bootstrap over series
known_truth_simulation.reading: Because promotion days are assigned by an independent coin flip in the generator, the effect is identified. The estimate is compared with the generator's documented +25%; log(1+units) and rounding make a small bias plausible. This checks the estimator, not any real business.
